blockers.why: HTTP 403 returned an HTML security page. A pre-existing SI text derivative was reused for textual quotations; the native figure artwork was not independently inspected.
blockers.needed_for: Native-figure visual confirmation only. Class counts and bypass lengths came from archived author notebook outputs and the author RDS data object.

verdict_reason: The three Fig. S20B class counts reproduce exactly from the dossier input and agree with the author notebook frequencies. For Fig. S20D, GraphFLA's all-length bypass proportion matches the author source-data cumulative endpoint at L=29 and rounds to the printed 23%; GraphFLA does not return the full length-resolved curve. Fig. S20A's accessible-path framing agrees with GraphFLA's directed square classes. The publisher SI PDF itself returned HTTP 403, so the native artwork was not independently inspected.
